SELECT I.ITEM_NO, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HAS_SIZE, I.HAS_QUANTITY, I.ORDERNO, I.REMARK, I.ACTIVITY FROM HR_UNIFORM_ITEM I WHERE I.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND I.ACTIVITY = 1
AND I.ACTIVITY IN (0, 1)
ORDER BY I.ACTIVITY DESC, I.ORDERNO, I.ITEM_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE HR_UNIFORM_ITEM SET ITEM_NAME = #{itemName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HAS_SIZE = #{hasSize, jdbcType=CHAR}, HAS_QUANTITY = #{hasQuantity, jdbcType=CHAR}, ORDERNO = #{orderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACTIVITY = #{activity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ITEM_NO = #{itemNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.sql: SELECT C.CHANGE_NO, C.PERSON_ID, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(MAX(PI.SEXCODE), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI WHERE PI.PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID) AS SEX_NAME, TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(C.CHANGE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(C.CHANGE_DATE, 'MM/YYYY') AS CHANGE_MONTH, C.REASON, C.REMARK, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(C.CHANGE_DATE, #{intervalMonths, jdbcType=NUMERIC}), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NEXT_ELIGIBLE_DATE

FROM HR_UNIFORM_CHANGE C INNER JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HE ON HE.PERSON_ID = C.PERSON_ID WHERE C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.CHANGE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{month, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM') AND C.CHANGE_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM'), 1)
AND ( UPPER(HE.EMPID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HE.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(C.REASON)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' )
mapper.select: FROM HR_UNIFORM_CHANGE C INNER JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HE ON HE.PERSON_ID = C.PERSON_ID WHERE C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.CHANGE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{month, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM') AND C.CHANGE_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{month, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM'), 1) ORDER BY C.CHANGE_DATE, C.CHANGE_NO

SELECT HE.PERSON_ID, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(MAX(PI.SEXCODE), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO PI WHERE PI.PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID) AS SEX_NAME, TO_CHAR(HE.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(L.LAST_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS LAST_CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(L.LAST_DATE, #{intervalMonths, jdbcType=NUMERIC}), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS NEXT_ELIGIBLE_DATE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE LEFT JOIN (SELECT C.PERSON_ID, MAX(C.CHANGE_DATE) AS LAST_DATE FROM HR_UNIFORM_CHANGE C WHERE C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY C.PERSON_ID) L ON L.PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID WHERE UPPER(HE.EMPID) = UPPER(TRIM(#{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND HE.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM HR_UNIFORM_CHANGE_DETAIL WHERE CHANGE_NO = #{changeNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HR_UNIFORM_CHANGE_DETAIL (CHANGE_NO, ITEM_NO, ITEM_SIZE, QUANTITY) VALUES (#{changeNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemSize, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
